rothman2024.notes: Peak values transcribed from authors review of Oriowo; period geometric mean is not treated as a time-integrated AUC.

estrogel_fda.population: UMD-01-078, 0.75 mg E2 in 1.25 g 0.06% gel on one arm; not washed; baseline-adjusted

patch_label.population: Original twice-weekly formulation, abdomen; 50 microgram/day; Table 2 footnote: 80 h

estrannaise_temporal_priors.notes: Only injection transfer and effective turnover temporal priors are reused; amplitude and depot absorption refitted to reported study peaks. These are effective rates, not physiological E2 clearance.

assumptions: Population reference responses, not a patient-specific or clinically validated prediction.
Linear superposition and dose scaling are modelling assumptions; no endogenous production, suppression or individualized fitting is inferred.
Reported unadjusted oral/sublingual and injection peaks cannot isolate baseline; they calibrate an effective response and may bias repeated-dose extrapolation.
Gel and patch models use the explicitly baseline-adjusted reference anchors; reference study baselines are not automatically added to user curves.
The gel model assumes absorption-limited 36 h terminal behavior and a 1 h systemic turnover prior; reported uncertainty is large.
Patch model uses nominal release rate as an empirical reservoir driver; it never interprets patch total drug loading as delivered dose.
Only listed chemical forms, formulations and administration routes are admitted; IM is not automatically applied to SC.
